'''Virtual Set 3: Revolution''' is the third of the [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|numbered Virtual Sets]] the [[Players Committee]] released between 2002 and 2009. Each of its 50 cards is a printed slip that replaces the bottom half of a [[Decipher]] card (new game text, stats and icons) while the card's title, lore and art stay as printed. The set became tournament-legal on 20 September 2002.<ref name="legal" /> In December 2006 the Committee reissued it as a ''Remaster'' sheet with new pack art, a set symbol and the final text; that sheet is the source for the slips shown here.<ref name="ia" /> Icons used on the slips are explained at [[Virtual card icons]].

The second image in each row is a full-card remaster: the printed Decipher card with the slip re-typeset at 600 DPI in the style of the Committee's later Holotable cards, made for the wiki in 2026 (see [[Typography of Star Wars CCG cards]]). These are fan reconstructions, not Committee products. Game text is written out the way the sheet's icon key defines its shorthand.
